items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A message set into the page that stays until it is dealt with, as a card in a tray of its tone.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A question that must be answered before the page can be used again, with the answers side by side under it.

items.name: area-chart
items.title: Area Chart
items.description: Filled bands over time, stacked or overlaid.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person or a team as a picture, or their initials in a colour of their own, with a badge and a group that opens up.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A short label for a state or a kind, tinted in its theme colour, with a dot for a state that is still changing.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar Chart
items.description: Categories compared by length, grouped or stacked.

items.name: bar-picker
items.title: Bar Picker
items.description: A short run of values as columns of lights, one column picked.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: The trail of links back up a hierarchy to the page you are on, with the middle folded away when the path runs long.

items.name: bubble-chart
items.title: Bubble Chart
items.description: One labelled circle per row, on two measured axes, with a third quantity on each circle's area.

items.name: bump-chart
items.title: Bump Chart
items.description: How a set of things ranked against each other over time.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Something to press, in the weight its action deserves, with a spinner for while it works.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Related buttons joined into one control, with separators, text cells and fields between them.

items.name: candlestick-chart
items.title: Candlestick Chart
items.description: Open, high, low and close for a period, drawn as one mark.

items.name: canvas
items.title: Canvas
items.description: A surface of dots, lines or crosses for other components to sit on, with a light that can follow the pointer.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A surface that holds one thing, with a heading, an action beside it and a footer.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: One choice that is on or off, with a tick that draws itself and a parent box for a group.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: A pill that can be pressed: a filter turned on and off, or an added value with a × to take it out.

items.name: choice-cards
items.title: Choice Cards
items.description: One option chosen from a few, each shown as a picture of what it does.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A text field that filters a list of options as you type.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A launcher: type to find a page, an app or an action, and run it with Enter.

items.name: command-dock
items.title: Command Dock
items.description: A small button that opens into a field, with the answer arriving under it a row at a time.

items.name: day-grid
items.title: Day Grid
items.description: A run of days as a field of dots, each sized by how much happened on it.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A task done in a panel over the page, with its buttons in the band beneath it.

items.name: feedback
items.title: Feedback
items.description: A dialog with a well to write in and two actions in the band around it.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A form control with its label, a line of help and its error, wired to each other.

items.name: flow
items.title: Flow
items.description: A canvas of nodes joined by edges, that you pan, zoom and rearrange.

items.name: frame
items.title: Frame
items.description: A panel of rows set into a tray, with the tray's top strip carrying the title.

items.name: funnel-chart
items.title: Funnel Chart
items.description: Where a population drained away, one step at a time.

items.name: heatmap-chart
items.title: Heatmap Chart
items.description: A calendar of bins, shaded by how much happened in each.

items.name: hex-chart
items.title: Hex Chart
items.description: A whole broken into parts, counted out in hexagonal cells.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single line to type into, with icons, units and buttons set inside its box.

items.name: inspector
items.title: Inspector
items.description: The settings panel beside an editor's canvas: a rail of icons, each opening a page of titled sections.

items.name: kpi
items.title: KPI
items.description: One number and what it is doing: its change, its shape over time, its progress to a target.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: The name of a field, with its required mark, a hint and an action on one line.

items.name: lane-board
items.title: Lane Board
items.description: Lanes of cards that can be dragged within a lane and from one lane to another.

items.name: line-chart
items.title: Line Chart
items.description: A series over time, drawn in from the left.

items.name: live-line-chart
items.title: Live Line Chart
items.description: A reading that keeps arriving, against a window that keeps moving.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: A list of actions that opens from a button, with shortcuts, checks and submenus.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: One turn of a conversation with an assistant: a person's bubble, or an answer set as prose with actions under it.

items.name: mirror-area-chart
items.title: Mirror Area Chart
items.description: Two readings of one timeline, one above a baseline and one below it.

items.name: model-picker
items.title: Model Picker
items.description: A select for the model a message goes to, searched by name, filtered by provider and starred.

items.name: nav-rail
items.title: Nav Rail
items.description: A collapsible sidebar of destinations that keeps one active pill sliding between rows, and folds to a column of icons with tooltips.

items.name: not-found
items.title: Not Found
items.description: An error code drawn in pixels that come apart near the pointer, with a title and a way out.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page controls for a long result set: the pages near you, the gaps between them, and a way across.

items.name: pie-chart
items.title: Pie Chart
items.description: One total, divided between its parts.

items.name: planet
items.title: Planet
items.description: The world as dots on a globe you can turn, with markers pinned to it.

items.name: plot
items.title: Plot
items.description: A chart you assemble from marks on one shared scale, for the shapes the named charts do not cover.

items.name: polar-area-chart
items.title: Polar Area Chart
items.description: Several readings compared on one measure, as a dial.

items.name: prompt
items.title: Prompt
items.description: A field for writing to an assistant, with its files, model and tools in one card.

items.name: pyramid-chart
items.title: Pyramid Chart
items.description: Two series mirrored about a centre line, one row per category, on one shared scale.

items.name: radar-chart
items.title: Radar Chart
items.description: Several measures of one thing, drawn as one shape.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: One choice from a short list, with every option visible and the arrow keys moving between them.

items.name: range-meter
items.title: Range Meter
items.description: A reading on a ruler of ticks that rises where the value is, with the number above it.

items.name: ring-chart
items.title: Ring Chart
items.description: Progress towards several targets, as concentric arcs.

items.name: rolling-number
items.title: Rolling Number
items.description: A number whose digits roll to their new values.

items.name: sankey-chart
items.title: Sankey Chart
items.description: Where a quantity came from and where it ended up, as ribbons between stages.

items.name: scatter-chart
items.title: Scatter Chart
items.description: Two measured quantities against each other, to show how they relate.

items.name: scroll-header
items.title: Scroll Header
items.description: A page title with room around it that hands over to a compact sticky bar as the reader scrolls.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A button that opens a list of options and shows the one chosen.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that rises from an edge of the screen, floating clear of it, and leaves with a swipe.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A number set by dragging along a track, with its name and value written inside it.

items.name: soundwave
items.title: Soundwave
items.description: A voice drawn while an app listens: capsules, bars, a line, a field of dots, spokes round a person, or rings of dots.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Something working that has not finished: an arc, spokes, dots, an orbit, a pulse or a dither cell.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: One figure written large, with a label over it, a unit after it and a badge beside it.

items.name: steps
items.title: Steps
items.description: A flow that moves one stop at a time, its numbered stops joined by a line that fills as far as you have got.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: On or off, for a setting that takes effect the moment it changes.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Rows of records with the same columns, with numbers aligned and a header that stays pinned.

items.name: table-of-contents
items.title: Table of Contents
items.description: The sections of a long page as a quiet rail, with one mark that moves to what you are reading.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: A few views of one thing, one at a time, chosen from a row of tabs whose marker slides to the one chosen.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A field for more than one line that grows as it is written in, up to a limit.

items.name: tilt-card
items.title: Tilt Card
items.description: A card that leans towards the pointer, with layers inside it that move by their depth.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Time laid out left to right: tracks of clips under a ruler, with a playhead.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A short message that leaves on its own, with a title that changes through dither.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: A strip of tools and actions for an editor, with one tool chosen at a time.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short hint about a control while it is hovered or focused: a pill, a card, its keys or a status.

items.name: treemap-chart
items.title: Treemap Chart
items.description: A total, cut into the parts it is made of, sized by area.

items.name: usage
items.title: Usage
items.description: How full a model's context or a plan is, as a small indicator that opens into the figures.

items.name: waterfall-chart
items.title: Waterfall Chart
items.description: How a run of changes carried one total to another, with each step floating on the running balance.

items.name: workbench
items.title: Workbench
items.description: The frame of an editor: a canvas with the work on it, a toolbar over it, an inspector beside it and a timeline under it.

items.name: xy-pad
items.title: XY Pad
items.description: Two numbers set with one drag: a point moved across a field.
